_comment: Twin of the Agent Registry entries the Helpdesk agent's gateway uses (europe-west4). Shape follows Google's manual-registration example: a toolspec.json with MCP tool annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint) that WHOEVER REGISTERS THE SERVER declares; Agent Registry does not introspect a manually registered server. Hosts are on the documentation domain example.com.
location: europe-west4 (custom servers and endpoints); global (Google-managed MCP servers)

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Adds an internal comment to a ticket.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Sends an email from the helpdesk mailbox.

mcpServers.name: projects/example-agents-prod/locations/global/mcpServers/bigquery

tools.name: list_dataset_ids
tools.description: Returns the IDs of datasets in a project.

tools.name: list_table_ids
tools.description: Returns the table IDs within a dataset.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Runs a SQL query and returns the result (the one tool that isn't read-only).

tools.name: execute_sql_readonly
tools.description: Runs a read-only SQL query and returns the result.

mcpServers._lab_note: Google-managed remote MCP server: registered automatically in the 'global' location when the BigQuery API is enabled; Google's page lists six tools and says execute_sql is the only one that isn't read-only. The resource ID here is illustrative.

endpoints.name: projects/example-agents-prod/locations/europe-west4/endpoints/aiplatform
endpoints._lab_note: Model calls, Sessions and Memory Bank. With a default-deny gateway the agent needs these endpoints registered and allowed (Google's routing page).
